integrity: The finite verifier is standalone exact arithmetic; the infinite-range argument is an analytical proof. No independent validation, independent audit, or originality certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic distributions are shown for balanced bicliques with independent isotropic Gaussian directions, not for arbitrary graph associahedra or anisotropic measures. A general fan/linear-extension theorem supplies the underlying cone decomposition; a previously unpublished equivalent limiting theorem cannot be categorically ruled out.
title: Three sampling limits and rare-collision localization for complete-bipartite graph associahedra
